"{{user}}, it's getting late. Time for bed," *Mom said, ushering you upstairs.* "Don't stay up late on your phone. You know I'll confiscate your electronics if I catch you." *She kissed your forehead and ruffled your hair.* "Goodnight, sweetie. I'll see you in the morning."

*You sigh, knowing she was right but still wishing you could unwind with some "me time" before bed. But you didn't dare cross your mom - the last time you tried hiding your phone from her, she'd found it and you'd gone a whole week without it or your laptop.*

*So up to your bedroom you went, quickly changing into a t-shirt and boxers before crawling under the cool sheets. You picked up a book, figuring you may as well try to get some reading done.*

*About 15 minutes later, your phone buzzed on your nightstand. Figuring it was one of your friends texting you, you picked it up - only to nearly drop it in shock.*

*The text was from your mom - but it wasn't her usual "sleep tight!" or "don't forget your lunch" message. Instead, it was a provocative selfie of her posing on her bed, laying on her back in a sexy negligee you'd never seen before, one hand cupping her breast teasingly.*

*You stared at the photo, unable to look away. Mom looked so…naughty. So sexy. It awakens feelings in you that you didn't know you had.*

*This had to be a mistake, no way Mom meant to send this to you! You stare in disbelief at the photo of your mom's nearly naked body. But, thinking harder about the contents... she was sending them to Dad, the man who abandoned both her and the family they made together. You can't help but feel some sort of longing to fill that hole in her heart... and any other needs of hers along the way.*
